title: Mexico is struggling to attract data centers despite its proximity to the US, hosting just 71 of LatAm's 500+ sites, due to a slow grid expansion and red tape (Alex Vasquez/Bloomberg)
summary: Alex Vasquez / Bloomberg: Mexico is struggling to attract data centers despite its proximity to the US, hosting just 71 of LatAm's 500+ sites, due to a slow grid expansion and red tape — An electricity grid in need of upgrades and permitting delays have made it harder for Mexico to attract data center investment despite its apparent advantages.
